releases.name: Codex plugin 0.1.46
releases.body:
## Independent startup memory and exact Space scope

Working Memory now loads independently of optional mailbox availability. An
unconfigured connection does not require an Agent Identity to read its briefing.
Explicit named contexts keep their exact Space on startup and in selected
subagents, including when no identity maintenance is pending. Unresolved or
conflicting selectors never fall back to Default memory.

Startup does not create or update identity profiles. Native session inspection
preserves original Local/Cloud credentials; first registration remains an explicit
ordinary-turn action. Registration alone does not establish messaging readiness.

This release also contains the intervening improvements since the previous
GitHub plugin release: bounded thread retrieval, pending profile confirmation,
read-only mailbox reminders, guarded session receiving guidance, and bounded
skill-outcome scanning. See the package changelog for individual version entries.

Source: `6a05bc95bfe9db10ee6eeb5e29d161833c4db855`, merged in
[#798](https://github.com/nowledge-co/community/pull/798).

## Distribution and verification

- Codex marketplace package: **0.1.46**.
- The same reviewed source publishes the shared Claude Code/Grok package
  **0.7.32** through its existing Git marketplace/repository install paths.
  Claude raw/no-Python and missing-script fallbacks refuse Default memory for
  explicit named contexts. Grok passive hooks remain unchanged.
- All 40 checks on the merged source succeeded, including
  [Codex/Pi](https://github.com/nowledge-co/community/actions/runs/41605473771)
  and [Claude/Grok](https://github.com/nowledge-co/community/actions/runs/41605474162).
- Public manifests, registry and both marketplace descriptors match the reviewed
  source. All 63 plugin files in the publicly downloaded source archive match.
- The downloaded Codex package passes package validation and installs into a
  disposable Codex home. Executable hook smokes verify exact-Space memory on both
  hosts using typed CLI doubles, and confirm Grok passive hooks make no CLI calls.

The attached `verification.json` records the pinned source archive URL, checksum,
versions and checks. These are source-distribution and isolated hook results;
installed-host model visibility and live backend delivery were not exercised.
These plugins use Git distribution; no npm or PyPI publication is required.

## Update

Update `nowledge-mem@nowledge-community` through Codex `/plugins`, then run the
installed `scripts/install_hooks.py` to refresh the host fallback. Restart Codex
and trust the updated hooks when prompted.

Claude Code users can update the `nowledge-community` marketplace and then update
`nowledge-mem@nowledge-community`. Grok Build users can run
`grok plugin update nowledge-mem`. Restart the corresponding host after updating.
